features.title: Focused hunter
features.text: Track a chosen prey and fight with a style shaped by your hunter's edge. Bows, paired weapons, companions and optional focus spells offer different approaches.

features.title: Hunt Prey
features.text: Choose a target to improve pursuit and apply your edge's specific benefits. Your feats can emphasize damage, knowledge, teamwork or a companion.
